$description: Declared role pairs for the WCAG 2.2 AA contrast check (scripts/contrast-check.mjs). fg and bg are semantic role names (color.theme.<theme>.<role>) or full token paths. kind is text (4.5:1), large-text (3:1; at least 24 px, or 18.66 px bold), boundary (3:1) or decoration (no threshold, a visible exemption); it can be an object with a kind per theme. AMBER RULE: accent-fill (amber) as the foreground of a text or boundary pair on a paper background fails the check.

pairs.note: In the dark theme fg is paper, which is only about 2.5:1 on amber; text on an amber fill is on-accent (ink) in both themes, so this pair is a text pair on light only.
Hairlines are decorative; any boundary that carries meaning (focus ring, input border) needs a 3:1 boundary pair of its own.
Amber on the page ground: fills and decoration only, never text or a boundary (the amber rule).
White on amber is the accent decoration (echo, fish body), never text.
